title: Time And How To Spend It

questions.q: What does research say brings more lasting happiness than material goods?
questions.why: The text notes happiness comes more from experiences than anything else.

questions.q: Which activity was found to improve mood and lower cortisol more than treadmill walking?
questions.why: Forest bathing study showed walking in woods outperformed treadmill walking.

questions.q: How many hours of free time does the average person have each day?
questions.why: The overview states the average person has over five hours of free time daily.

questions.q: What state describes being fully immersed and energized in an activity?
questions.why: The text defines flow as being in the zone, fully immersed and energized.

questions.q: Which fear often makes people think they lack time for leisure?
questions.why: The text cites fear of missing out (FOMO) as a cause of perceived time scarcity.
